name: Chasca
description: A fierce archer who channels the swift winds of Natlan’s mountains. Chasca is known for her sharp instincts and unshakable resolve in battle.

name: Citlali
description: A calm and thoughtful mage who wields icy magic with precise control. Citlali is deeply connected to Natlan’s ancestral traditions and respects the spirits of the land.

name: Iansan
description: A fiery young warrior gifted with natural agility and fierce determination. Iansan’s lightning-fast movements leave her opponents stunned and overwhelmed.

name: Ifa
description: A free-spirited wanderer who listens to the stories carried by the wind. Ifa is gentle but wise, often guiding others with quiet philosophical insight.

name: Kachina
description: A steadfast guardian dedicated to protecting her tribe’s sacred grounds. Kachina carries herself with unwavering discipline and a deep sense of honor.

name: Kinich
description: A fearless warrior who draws strength from Natlan’s dense wilderness. Kinich’s presence commands respect, and his actions speak louder than words.

name: Mavuika
description: A proud fighter who channels volcanic force into every swing. Mavuika’s passion burns brightly, inspiring allies and intimidating foes.

name: Mualani
description: A serene water dancer who moves gracefully like flowing currents. Mualani radiates calm energy, bringing balance and harmony to every encounter.

name: Ororon
description: A mischievous archer known for her unpredictable fighting style. Ororon embraces chaos, turning every battle into a whirlwind of electrifying shots.

name: Varesa
description: A powerful priestess who channels sacred lightning through ritualistic magic. Varesa carries great responsibility and leads with both strength and compassion.

name: Xilonen
description: An honorable warrior who blends tradition with fearless adaptability. Xilonen’s blade techniques reflect the strength and wisdom of Natlan’s ancient lineage.
